verification_report.summary: The proof is correct and complete. It constructs a longest trail using finiteness and the existence of an edge, proves the trail is closed by combining the endpoint incidence-parity argument with the even-degree hypothesis, and then uses connectedness plus cyclic rotation to show that any unused edge would extend the trail. Every edge is therefore traversed exactly once. All stated hypotheses are used, and no prohibited or unsupported citations, conditional premises, vague appeals, or non-self-contained hypotheses occur.
